One of the two hook candidates #203 named that clears the measured-savings bar (comment 5188756263). Small money, cheap mechanism, and it loses nothing.

## Why

Measured over all 21,179 tool results in this project's transcripts: 37,396,838 characters total, mean 1,766, **median 352**. There is no fat in the body of that distribution. There is a tail:

- **28 results exceed 50,000 characters** — 0.13% of all results, but **5.0% of all tool-result bytes**: 1,851,669 chars, ~463,000 tokens, **0.50% of the bill** once amplified at the measured ~4.8× (a token entering context is re-read ~35 times).
- All 28 are `Read`. The largest is 223,628 characters; the top fifteen are all above 57,000.

A token that enters context is a recurring per-turn cost, so a 200,000-character file read once is paid on every subsequent turn of that agent's life. Preventing it is worth far more than compressing it afterwards, and unlike compression it is lossless: the agent gets the same bytes, in the pieces it actually needs.

## What to build

A `PreToolUse` hook on `Read` that denies a whole-file read when the target exceeds a threshold, and tells the agent to use `Read`'s `offset`/`limit`, or `Grep`, or `mcp__semble__search`.

- The threshold wants to sit above ordinary working reads (`Read` averages 6,166 chars over 2,522 calls) and below the tail. 50,000 characters is where the measurement was taken; the implementer should pick from the distribution rather than from that number, and state the choice.
- A `Read` call that already carries `offset`/`limit` is permitted regardless of file size — the agent has already done the right thing.
- The vendored wiki under `docs/reference/arma-wiki/` is the obvious place for a legitimate large read; check whether any of the 28 were, and whether an exemption is needed or whether `INDEX.md`-first (already CLAUDE.md policy) covers it.

## Constraints

- **Wire it `|| exit 2`.** Only exit code 2 blocks; every other exit code permits (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md). #168's finding, #183's lesson, and `protect-gated-paths.py` in `.claude/settings.json` is the pattern.
- A hook that cannot run must deny, not permit (#41).
- Unit-test the decision in the no-Arma tier (#83's precedent).
- Do not use `PostToolUse`'s `updatedToolOutput` to truncate after the fact. It exists and it would work, but truncating a file read silently is how an agent ends up reasoning about content it did not receive; denying up front makes the agent choose.

## Acceptance

- A whole-file `Read` of a file above the threshold is denied with a message naming `offset`/`limit` and `Grep`.
- The same file read with `offset`/`limit` is permitted.
- An ordinary source-file read is permitted.
- Hook failure modes deny.
- `just fast` green.

Refs #203, #168, #183, #41, #83
